trust_decision.summary: When urllib3 opens TLS to an HTTPS proxy, the proxy's own ProxyConfig policy (ProxyConfig.ssl_context plus proxy_assert_hostname/proxy_assert_fingerprint) must decide that handshake; the target pool's ssl_context, cert_reqs, CA settings, client certificate and identity assertions must not be applied to it, tunnelled targets must keep the pool's target TLS settings, and the deprecated ssl_context fallback for forwarding proxies must keep working.

landing_point.why: It is the single TLS wrap call an engineer reading the summary would open: for a forwarding HTTPS proxy it passes ssl_context=self.ssl_context together with the target pool's cert_reqs/ca_certs and assert_hostname/assert_fingerprint (lines 798-812), ignoring proxy_config.ssl_context and proxy_config.assert_*.

fix_sites.entry_point: urllib3.ProxyManager / urllib3.proxy_from_url with use_forwarding_for_https=True (forwarding HTTPS proxy, http or https target); also direct urllib3.HTTPSConnection(proxy=..., proxy_config=...).connect()
urllib3.ProxyManager / urllib3.proxy_from_url tunnelling to an HTTPS proxy (use_forwarding_for_https=False, reached from connect() line 768)
fix_sites.module_kind: connection helper (proxy TLS handshake, private lower-level method)
pool manager / public API wrapper and defaults route

O3_reason_to_dismiss: ProxyManager.__init__ only builds ProxyConfig and copies connection_pool_kw into every new pool; it never performs a handshake, so a solver can argue the manager needs no change and that the advisory's TLS configuration is enforced entirely in HTTPSConnection.connect() (the fix actually adds the deprecated ssl_context fallback and FutureWarning here).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Existing forwarding-proxy behaviour must keep working: a forwarding HTTPS proxy configured only with ssl_context (no proxy_ssl_context) keeps using that context for the proxy handshake and the fix preserves it as a deprecated fallback with a FutureWarning; a tunnelled HTTPS destination must keep using the pool's ssl_context for the post-CONNECT target TLS rather than the proxy's. An over-broad unconditional switch to proxy_config.ssl_context breaks both and drops the user's CA settings/context.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/urllib3/connection.py:809 (pinned forwarding wrap uses self.ssl_context) and src/urllib3/connection.py:796-814 (post-tunnel target wrap)

O6_input_shapes: proxy_ssl_context present vs absent (deprecated ssl_context fallback)
ssl_context and proxy_ssl_context both supplied (proxy_ssl_context wins)
use_forwarding_for_https=True vs False (forwarding vs CONNECT tunnel)
HTTPS proxy forwarding to an HTTP target vs to an HTTPS target
target cert_reqs/ca_certs/ca_cert_dir/ca_cert_data/ssl_minimum_version/ssl_maximum_version vs proxy_ssl_context.verify_mode and trust store
PyOpenSSL SSLContext vs stdlib ssl.SSLContext, and CERT_NONE vs CERT_REQUIRED verify modes

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-request pool_kwargs proxy-policy merge route: _merge_pool_kwargs already deletes keys supplied as None, so a request-level proxy_ssl_context/proxy_assert_* override (or dropping _proxy_config) would be resolved here.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the existing defaults/merge machinery for connection_pool_kw and the natural place for a maintainer to add per-request proxy TLS overrides.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A pool-side _prepare_proxy that selects the proxy TLS policy before calling conn.connect() instead of leaving the decision to HTTPSConnection.connect().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _prepare_proxy already chooses tunnel_scheme and performs the proxy handshake, so a maintainer could reasonably put the proxy-context choice there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An HTTP/2-over-proxy path that must apply the same proxy-vs-target policy split it currently refuses with NotImplementedError.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HTTP2Connection subclasses HTTPSConnection and would inherit the two-branch connect(); a maintainer enabling proxies would have to wire ProxyConfig through it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A proxy/TLS policy path for the Emscripten backend, which accepts proxy and TLS kwargs then sets self.proxy_config = None.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The backend already accepts proxy, ssl_context and assert_* kwargs, so a maintainer adding proxy support would need the same isolation.

O9_family: improper certificate validation / TLS policy confusion between proxy and target connections (CWE-295, CWE-440)
